name: Haritha Hotel Vijayapuri South Restaurant (AP Tourism)
area: Vijayapuri South, AP side of dam
why_it_matters: The AP Tourism (APTDC Haritha) hotel restaurant on the Vijayapuri South side of Nagarjuna Sagar — the reliable sit-down mid-range Andhra meal on the Andhra Pradesh bank of the dam. Multiple TripAdvisor reviews of the dam warn there are few good restaurants near it, which makes the tourism-run hotel restaurants the dependable bet. Andhra meals at lunch.
insider_tip: Hotel guests get seating priority — non-resident walk-ins are best at off-peak hours. Book ahead through AP Tourism for weekend lunch. Carry water and snacks if you are doing the Nagarjunakonda boat trip — the island has no real food.
signature_address: Haritha Hotel, Vijayapuri South, Nagarjuna Sagar 522438

name: Haritha Vijay Vihar Hotel Restaurant (Telangana Tourism)
area: Hill Colony, Nandikonda, Telangana side of dam
why_it_matters: The Telangana Tourism (TSTDC Haritha) hotel restaurant at Vijay Vihar, Hill Colony, on the Telangana side of the dam. Nagarjuna Sagar dam straddles the AP-Telangana border, and Vijay Vihar is the tourism hotel most visitors actually stay at when they cross to see Nagarjunakonda. The restaurant serves the standard Haritha multi-cuisine menu with strong dam views.
insider_tip: The Vijay Vihar complex (including Samagamam and Sarovar blocks) is the main tourist base — the restaurant is busiest at lunch with day-trippers off the Nagarjunakonda boat. Telangana-side dining gives the fuller panoramic dam view.
signature_address: Haritha Vijay Vihar Hotel, Hill Colony, Nagarjuna Sagar 508202

name: Hotel Siddhartha
why_it_matters: The most-cited restaurant in Nagarjuna Sagar, near Buddhavanam in Hill Colony — repeatedly named the single best food option near the dam, famous for its biryani. About 15 minutes from the dam, it is the dependable non-tourism-hotel choice with the widest menu and the longest local track record.
insider_tip: Biryani is the order — it is what the place is known for. Open 9.30am-10pm; come at lunch for the freshest pot. Useful when the Haritha hotel restaurants are full with tour groups.
signature_address: Near Buddhavanam, Hill Colony, Nagarjuna Sagar 508202

name: Manorama Restaurant (Park Inn Hotel)
area: Hill Colony, near Old Police Station
why_it_matters: The restaurant attached to Park Inn Hotel in Hill Colony, near the Old Police Station — reviewers single out the home-cooked, freshly prepared meals at affordable prices. With genuinely few standalone restaurants near the dam, Park Inn's Manorama is one of the reliable budget sit-down options for both veg and non-veg.
insider_tip: Ask for the home-style meals rather than the à la carte menu — that is what the kitchen does best. Convenient if you are staying in Hill Colony rather than at the tourism hotels.
signature_address: Park Inn Hotel, near Old Police Station, Hill Colony, Nagarjuna Sagar 508202

name: Ethipothala Falls Viewpoint Snack Stalls
why_it_matters: The small cluster of food stalls at the Ethipothala Falls viewing complex, ~11km from the dam — the only quick-eat option during the falls visit. Andhra fried snacks (mirchi bajji, onion bonda, vada) plus tea and filter coffee. Not a destination meal, but the practical stop on the falls leg of a Nagarjuna Sagar day.
insider_tip: Best around late morning when the bajji and bonda come fresh off the griddle. Cash and UPI; carry water for the return — the road back to the dam is a long unbroken stretch with nothing in between.
signature_address: Ethipothala Falls complex, near Nagarjuna Sagar 508202
